integrity: The forward Green–Ampt formula and parameter-estimation setting are prior work. Mathematical priority of the sharp inverse-domain and boundary asymptotics is provisional; relevant historical sources without full-text comparisons are identified. Self-review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-point cumulative observations, uninterrupted ideal Green–Ampt ponding, known initial time and depth, and finite strictly positive effective parameters only. Not a falling-head, noisy, stratified, or variable-rainfall theorem.
title: Sharp two-observation feasibility and endpoint identifiability in ponded Green–Ampt infiltration
